verdict.rationale: Canny's Autopilot runs in the background, automatically capturing feedback from Gong, Intercom, Slack, Fathom, Fireflies and other sources. Native integrations also keep statuses in sync with Jira, Linear, GitHub and similar tools. However, these are fixed, vendor-defined automations rather than workflows users configure themselves, and running 'agents that act on feedback' depends on an external LLM connected via MCP. Missing for 10: user-configurable automation rules or triggers, scheduled or autonomous agent workflows inside Canny, docs on setting up or controlling Autopilot, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
